anna: quick thread 1 — dense form validation decisions for the Model Create + Deploy flows. inline vs summary? and how to flag required fields in cramped rows? mike: short answer: both. inline for single-field errors, a summarized banner for cross-field/policy errors. keep banner keyboard-focusable with links. jamal: agree. also on required markers: asterisk-only == ambiguity. prefer an explicit token 'Required' in labels for dense variants, but allow a condensed 'Req' token if space is painfully tight. lexi: accessibility rules: don't use visual-only markers. either include visible 'Required' or add sr-only text so the programmatic name contains the required state. e.g. "". sam: i18n: make 'Required' a translation token. translators may need to reorder words in some languages. and use a muted color token so it isn't visually heavy. toni: layout shift concern: reserve helper/error space under inputs so errors change color + text but don't push the form. simple css: `.helper { min-height: 1.125rem; }` mike: for the summary banner, pattern should include concise heading, list of issues, and anchor links: "Fix" which moves focus to the input. on appearance, use aria-live=p olite or programmatic focus so SR users notice. anna: destructive confirm patterns? typed-confirm vs checkbox vs two-step toast — mobile pain is top-of-mind. jamal: scope-based rule works best: typed-confirm (exact phrase) only for org/cluster-level destructive actions that affect billing/data retention. per-resource deletes -> modal + required checkbox. reversible ops -> lighter confirm. lexi: typed-confirm accessibility: don't rely on placeholder. give an explicit label and announce mismatch errors with `role=\"alert\"`/`aria-live=\"assertive\"`. sample snippet: ```html
Text does not match
``` sam: mobile UX: if we must show typed text on phones, provide a copy-to-clipboard affordance and auto-select the text to reduce typing. but prefer checkbox for most deletes. toni: compact-grid question: show 'Required' on every subfield or show once per logical group? discoverability vs visual noise tradeoff. mike: compromise: show 'Required' on first column label in truly dense grids and show per-field on desktop/expanded. also expose a hover/tooltip to reveal requirements on smaller screens. lexi: i'll validate that with NVDA + VoiceOver tomorrow. ensure focus behavior from banner->field is smooth and announcements are clear. anna: proposed sprint decision: 1) tokenized 'Required' word in dense labels (with condensed fallback), 2) inline errors for single-field with reserved helper height + aria-invalid/aria-describedby, 3) pinned summary for cross-field/policy issues with focusable anchors, 4) typed-confirm only for org-level destructive actions; checkbox-confirm for resource deletes, 5) accessibility snippets (role=alert, aria-live, programmatic focus) and mobile copy affordances in the docs. jamal: can frontend add a tiny playground showing dense vs expanded label variants, pinned summary, and typed-confirm demo? will help PMs and translators. mike: yes 1 i'll open a PR with examples, CSS, and a11y code snippets. design-bot: created issue https://redwood.internals/issue/8155 "forms: dense validation + scoped confirm patterns" :white_check_mark: anna: thanks all i'll update figma tokens and the modal components after the PR lands. :thumbsup:
